text:
Noah (People Ops): Heads up: year-end onsite retreat in Austin on Jan 12-13. Its a two-day program (workshops + socials). Were piloting a travel & childcare stipend this time. RSVP + policy details: https://intra.redwood.example/retreat-jan
Evelyn (eng): Awesome. Is this open to remote folks too? Im in EU so travel is a bit tougher.
Noah (People Ops): Open to everyone. For international travel were offering up to $600 for economy flights (submit receipts). If travel is prohibitive, join virtually  well stream all sessions. Please indicate virtual/onsite on the RSVP.
Priya (product): Clarify childcare stipend? Thats amazing if so.
Jules (People Ops contractor): Yes, were offering a $150 childcare stipend per family per day (max $300 total) for those who need onsite childcare or to offset sitter costs while traveling. Add the childcare option on the form and attach receipts in Expensify using tag "RetreatJan2026".
Carlos (solutions): Will there be quiet rooms? Ill bring my toddler sometimes and might need a lactation/nap area.
Noah (People Ops): Well reserve a "Family & Wellness" room near the main hall for nursing/quiet breaks and baby changing. Sign-up slots will be available.
Evelyn (eng): Any guidance on expense pre-approval for higher fares? Sometimes flights >$600 due to schedules.
Jules (People Ops contractor): If you need an exception, put together a 2-line justification and cc Noah & finance@redwood.ai. We review exceptions case-by-case.
Priya (product): Hotels? Group block or reimbursements?
Noah (People Ops): Group block at Eastside Hotel (5min walk). Book under group code REDWOOD-RETREAT by Dec 28. Well reimburse up to $180/night for up to 2 nights. If you prefer an alternative, file with receipts.
CalendarBot: "Event: Redwood Year-End Retreat 12:00 PM Jan 12 - 4:00 PM Jan 13, Austin HQ
Location: Eastside Hotel + Redwood Austin Office
Please RSVP by Dec 20."
Carlos (solutions): Will there be project-level breakouts? My team needs to sync about the roadmap.
Priya (product): Yes, theres a morning slot on day 2 for team breakouts. Add topics to the agenda doc linked in the RSVP confirmation.
Evelyn (eng): Transportation from airport? Any shuttle or should we do rideshare?
Jules (People Ops contractor): Were arranging two shuttle rounds from AUS airport at 8:30AM and 10:00AM on Jan 12. Please select shuttle option on the form. Personal car parking will be validated for hotel guests.
Noah (People Ops): Accessibility note: if you need ASL interpretation or other accommodations, email ppl-ops@redwood.ai by Dec 15 so we can book services.
Priya (product): Food allergies?
Jules (People Ops contractor): The RSVP includes dietary restrictions; well label meals and offer GF/VG/DF/halal options.
Evelyn (eng): Will managers be required to approve travel time away for on-call folks?
Noah (People Ops): Please coordinate with your on-call lead. If youre on critical rotations and must stay remote, mark that on the form. Well try to sequence workshops to be flexible.
Carlos (solutions): Can partners/family attend the social dinner?
Noah (People Ops): Social dinner is staff-only due to venue capacity, sorry. Family-friendly daytime events are fine. If you want to bring a plus-one for daytime activities, indicate on the form and well provide a guest meal rate.
Priya (product): Deadline to RSVP?
Jules (People Ops contractor): RSVP by Dec 20 so we can lock rooms, shuttles, and catering. Late sign-ups may not be covered.
Evelyn (eng): RSVP submitted (virtual). Thank you!
Carlos (solutions): Pending approval for travel - will update here.
Noah (People Ops): Thanks everyone. Ping me or @Jules for any special requests. :sparkles:
